then.say: Mind the pole. Forty years I've lit the lamps of Wick's Rest, and I've only set two pilgrims on fire.
Tomas. Lamplighter. If you need the way somewhere, ask me. I've walked every road off this hill.
Nowhere, tonight. The bell's quiet up there for the first time in my life. Rest.
Both Seals? Then the great door in the Nave Approach will open for you. Up the Hill Stair, through the Abbey. The Chandler waits past it.
Up the Hill Stair, north, to the Abbey. Through the Porch and on to the Gatehouse.
The Tollwarden keeps it. He has the key to our Toll Gate, east of here. Every cart for the Works goes through him.

else.say: The great door of the Nave wants two Seals.

then.say: One is in the Tallow Works: east, through the Toll Gate you opened. Follow the carts.
One is down in the Waxmire: west, past the tents. It's the harder road. Keep to the reeds and out of the lanterns' light.

do.say: So the carts can find the road. So the pilgrims can find us. So the dark knows somebody's still here.
